items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: So I enjoyed playing with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Certain things he’ll say, that had to make you laugh. Because I think I’m bad about remembering days, and remembering who was on them, and what was who. And he was, he’d just forget days and different occasions or knowing somebody and he’d call somebody by their name totally not who the person is. And he’d sort of go through those humorous things. But playing-wise it was very good. That was the first time I’d ever played in any completely professional — you know that was a completely professional kind of…
And the thing with Monk became part of the film, didn’t it?
